stories.title: Mild and dry Monday-Tuesday, ahead of midweek storm and mountain snow
stories.summary: Areas of fog expected early Monday. Clearing and mild this afternoon. A midweek weather system will bring a chance of mountain snow and wind across the plains.

stories.title: Outside Days 2027 headliners revealed: See the lineup in Denver
stories.summary: The 4th annual Outside Days festival will be held at Auraria Campus in 2027 with Jack Johnson, Jungle, Sierra Ferrell, Big Wild, and Trevor Hall.

stories.title: Here's the holiday season TV schedule on NBC
stories.summary: NBC unveils its holiday 2026 schedule, featuring the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade and new specials like “Christmas With Snoop Dogg.”

stories.title: Colorado native named a 2027 Rhodes scholar
stories.summary: Elizabeth Koenck, of Aurora, Colorado, is among the 32 Americans named as 2027 Rhodes scholars.

stories.title: Paris Jackson announces Denver concert
stories.summary: Paris Jackson unveils her 2027 tour, "Happiest Day of My Life," starting in February in Los Angeles with stops across North America, Europe, and the UK.

stories.title: Volunteer gives hundreds of hours to Food Bank of the Rockies in honor of his parents
stories.summary: What keeps one longtime volunteer coming back is less about the shifts than about a lesson his father repeated at home.

stories.title: Time running out to dig up and store tropical bulbs before frost hits
stories.summary: Time is running out to dig up tropical bulbs like cannas and dahlias before the frost, as these bulbs can't withstand freezing temperatures.

stories.title: RTD plans 5.5-mile N Line extension
stories.summary: RTD launches the N Line Extension project to add 5.5 miles of rail, enhancing connectivity in the north metro Denver area.

stories.title: Weld County commits $1.3M for new traffic signal
stories.summary: Weld County allocates $1.3 million for a new traffic signal at a busy Colorado intersection, aiming to cut accidents by 50% in collaboration with CDOT.

stories.title: Denver City Council considers new protections for renters as health complaints more than double
stories.summary: Two proposals would require landlords to meet with tenant organizations and could redirect rental payments toward repairs at properties with unsafe living conditions

stories.title: Woman shot in possible attempted carjacking, Aurora police say
stories.summary: Police said the suspect fired a shot through a car window and hit the woman, leaving her with a gunshot wound that is not believed to be life-threatening.

stories.title: Missing 2-week-old baby from Westminster found safe in Texas
stories.summary: The Colorado Bureau of Investigation issued an Endangered Missing Alert Thursday after the boy's disappearance.
